name: By Stranger Trails
jem_summary: Complete one route: controlled Tusklin riding, a Cosmaw rescue, Spectre transport or a peaceful orca encounter. Controlled Endergrade travel also qualifies. Warped Toad is not a riding route for this goal. Running on sand using Roadrunner Boots is also a separate alternative.

pages.title: By Stranger Trails
pages.text: Complete one route: controlled Tusklin riding, a Cosmaw rescue, Spectre transport or a peaceful orca encounter. Controlled Endergrade travel also qualifies. Warped Toad is not a riding route for this goal. Running on sand using Roadrunner Boots is also a separate alternative.

pages.title: By Stranger Trails
pages.text: Different creatures help cross different dangerous environments.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Pacify Tusklin with brown mushrooms and equip Hogshoes; a saddle alone does not tame. Tame Cosmaw with Cosmic Cod and heal with chorus. Lure Spectre with Soul Heart and attach a lead. Peaceful orca swimming grants attack tempo; never hit the pod. Endergrade uses saddle and Chorus on a Stick; tame

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Warped Toad with mosquito larvae and heal it with maggots.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Roadrunner feathers make sand-running boots, a ground complement to gliders rather than a taming tier.
